dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's my group. We have an activity today.
dialogue.reading: ðæts maɪ ˈɡruːp. wiː ˈhæv ən ækˈtɪvəti təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We cook lunch for children at a school.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈkʊk ˈlʌntʃ fər ˈtʃɪldrən ət ə ˈskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. And Emma, my best friend, is in our group!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ənd ˈɛmə, maɪ ˌbɛst ˈfrɛnd, ɪz ɪn aʊər ˈɡruːp!
